decisions.reason: The modular extensions build on the core waste-to-energy offer and cost little to keep available, but the lack of visible activity in 2020 to 2021 suggests their value is resolving slowly, which raises the chance of withdrawal without yet justifying it.

As a flagship grounded in established capabilities, the waste oil plant remains a core option worth holding while its uncertainty resolves, even though the missing evidence from recent years tempers confidence.

The plastic-to-fuel plant still has high but uncertain upside and costs little to keep as an engineering offer, but uncertain regulatory and market conditions and no recent signals of traction raise the risk that the firm abandons it.
